versions.short: The bill would change the rules for a federal loan program that helps small businesses buy or build facilities, covering several areas: it would add workforce training requirements and new goals such as aiding disaster-recovery areas and supporting very small businesses, speed up the loan closing process with more allowed corrections and designated attorneys, require the Small Business Administration to run a marketing and outreach plan, relax limits on how much of a new or existing building a borrowing business may lease to others, and exempt certain development company loans from the requirement that applicants first seek credit elsewhere.
